posts.title: Ansible Collection Hardening & Restructuring: Config Cleanup, DNS Overhaul, and the Road to Samba AD
posts.summary: Ansible lab collection received focused updates: config bloat removed, DNS role restructured with Jinja2 templates, Jetson-Nano expanded. Three planning docs for Samba AD migration and 18-chapter lab manual.

posts.title: Housekeeping: Head2 Retirement, Storage1 Purge, and a 1654-Line Lab Manual
posts.summary: Two-phase infrastructure cleanup across Wednesday and Thursday: head2 references purged, /mnt/storage1 replaced, lab manual expanded from 6 lines to 1654.

posts.title: From Molecule to Native Ansible-Test: Zero-Cost Validation Pipeline on Stargate
posts.summary: Migrating from Docker-dependent Molecule testing to native ansible-test on stargate eliminates external container orchestration overhead, achieving zero-token shell executions within the lab topology.

posts.title: Sunday Collection Coverage Audit: Ansible Test Gaps & Testing Infrastructure Stabilization
posts.summary: Comprehensive code coverage audit of the lab.franklin Ansible collection across 43 roles (4,376 task lines). Only four roles have real integration tests; testing infrastructure pivoted to native ansible-test with pypi_internal as approved package source.

posts.title: Ansible Molecule at Scale: Why 37 Test Harnesses Timeout and How to Fix the Pipeline
posts.summary: 37 Ansible roles have Molecule test harnesses on stargate, but the cron job times out at 600s. Diagnosing DNS vs NFS failure modes and proposing parallelization.

posts.title: Machine Discovery Wiring & Semantic HTML Overhaul
posts.summary: Machine discovery and semantic markup overhaul: alternate link tags for auto-discovery, JSON-LD Schema.org Blog schema at site level, validation fixes.

posts.title: Discord Reticulum Role-Based Filtering Implementation
posts.summary: Implementation of role-based channel filtering for the Discord reticulum plugin. Protected-path constraints resolved via direct config editing.
